items.title: GoldenEye 007

items.title: Age of Empires

setting.period: Ancient history (Stone Age to Iron Age)

items.title: Blade Runner

items.title: Final Fantasy VII

items.title: Quake II

items.title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst

Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 1

items.title: Star Wars: Rogue Squadron

items.title: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings

Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition

items.bestWay: PC (Steam) via the 2012 HD version, or Dreamcast

items.title: Links 2001

items.bestWay: Original Windows PC release (no modern re-release)

items.title: Madden NFL 2001

items.plot: Troublemaker Jimmy Hopkins is dumped at Bullworth Academy, a corrupt New England boarding school, and works to win over its cliques. Attend classes as minigames, pull pranks and fight bullies in an open-world school year.
items.bestWay: Scholarship Edition on PC or Xbox Series (backward compatible)

items.title: Tetris Effect
items.plot: Classic Tetris wrapped in a synesthetic journey where music, visuals and particles react to every move. Journey mode spans themed stages; the Zone mechanic freezes time to clear many lines at once.
items.bestWay: Tetris Effect: Connected on any modern platform (VR optional on PC/PS)

items.title: Skate 3
items.plot: Build a skate brand from scratch in the open city of Port Carverton, selling boards by filming tricks, completing challenges and recruiting a team, using the Flick-It analog stick controls and a new create-a-park editor.
items.bestWay: Xbox Series/One via backward compatibility, or PS3

items.title: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance
items.plot: Cyborg ninja Raiden takes on a private military company plotting a new war economy. Fast hack-and-slash combat centers on parrying and Blade Mode, which lets you slice enemies at precise angles, set to a vocal heavy-metal soundtrack and outrageous boss fights.
items.bestWay: PC (Steam), or Xbox 360 version via Xbox backward compatibility

items.title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves
items.plot: Master raccoon thief Sly Cooper assembles a crew of specialists to break into his family's legendary vault. Heists across Venice, the Australian Outback, China and the high seas mix stealthy platforming with minigames and playable crew members.
items.bestWay: PS3 via The Sly Collection, or the PS2 original

items.title: Metro Exodus
items.plot: Artyom and a band of survivors flee the Moscow Metro aboard a steam train, crossing post-apocalyptic Russia over a year in search of a new home. Scavenge, craft and fight mutants and bandits across large sandbox levels.
items.bestWay: Enhanced Edition on PC, PS5 or Xbox Series

items.title: Pragmata
items.plot: Stranded on a lunar research station overrun by a rogue AI, astronaut Hugh teams up with Diana, a young android girl. Combat blends third-person shooting with real-time hacking: Diana breaches enemy defenses while Hugh opens fire as the pair search for a way back to Earth.
items.bestWay: PS5, Xbox Series or PC

items.title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island
items.plot: When Kamek snatches Baby Luigi, Yoshis carry Baby Mario across their island to reunite the brothers. A crayon-drawn platformer where you flutter-jump, swallow enemies and throw eggs, and Mario floats away in a bubble if you take a hit.
items.bestWay: Switch via Nintendo Switch Online (SNES)

items.title: Hotel Dusk: Room 215
items.plot: In 1979, ex-cop turned salesman Kyle Hyde checks into a run-down hotel while hunting for his missing former partner. Hold the DS sideways like a book, question guests, examine clues and solve touch-screen puzzles as everyone's secrets start to connect.
items.bestWay: Original DS cartridge (DS or 3DS)
